What can she read to have a baby boy? and what can she read to have a baby girl? And i had read on ur site that one can read Ya Latif 111 times after every fardh namaz with durood 11 time before and after for how many days should one do this? aprox how long does it take them to get married? JazakamuAllah Katira Answer ID: 13564 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 896/711=L/1430) A pregnant woman should recite the following duas in order to have pious and obedient child: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا But, you should leave the matter of baby boy and baby girl to Allah, whatever will be granted by Him will be better, in-sha-Allah. (2) There is no fixed time, but due to the blessing of the zikr it is hoped that one will get married soon and the hurdles will be removed. It is better to keep on reciting the dua until marriage. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
